meta.name: redis-core
meta.description: Core Redis modeling guidance — choose the right data structure (String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set, JSON, Stream, Vector Set) and use consistent colon-separated key names. Use when designing a Redis data model, caching objects, deciding between Hash and JSON, building counters, leaderboards, membership sets, or session stores, or when reviewing/cleaning up Redis key naming.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 挑对存储方式,统一命名规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用设计数据存储,想选对结构并统一命名
copy.tagline_en: Pick the right storage method and standardize your naming
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing app data storage and want to pick the right structure and naming.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按使用场景推荐合适的 Redis 数据结构,并制定冒号分隔的键名规范,同时指出把对象塞进字符串等常见反模式。
howto.when: 设计 Redis 数据模型、选择 Hash 或 JSON、构建计数器与排行榜等场景会触发;也用于审查或清理键名。

say.text: 帮我设计用户缓存模型,该用 Hash 还是 JSON?
say.note: Claude 按访问模式给出选型和键名。

say.text: 我要建一个排行榜,Redis 里怎么存?
say.note: Claude 推荐 Sorted Set 并给键名。

say.text: 这些键名大小写混乱,怎么统一规范?
say.note: Claude 按冒号分隔规则修正。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will recommend the right Redis data structure for your access pattern, define colon-separated key-name conventions, and flag anti-patterns like stuffing flat objects into strings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design a Redis data model, choose between Hash and JSON, or build counters, leaderboards, member sets, session stores, etc.; also when reviewing or cleaning up key names.

say_en.text: Help me design a user cache model — should I use Hash or JSON?
say_en.note: Claude picks a type and gives keys.

say_en.text: I want to build a leaderboard. How should I store it in Redis?
say_en.note: Claude recommends a Sorted Set with key names.

say_en.text: These key names are inconsistent. How do I standardize them?
